title: High-Pressure Car Wash Gun – Adjustable Hose Nozzle
descriptionHtml:
Wash the car with real pressure – without an expensive pressure washer

An ordinary garden hose can't rinse away dirt and winter grit properly. The result is scratches from scrubbing, and a wash that takes twice as long.

A powerful jet straight from the hose

The nozzle concentrates the water into a powerful high-pressure jet that rinses away mud, dust and grit before you even touch the paint. The adjustable spray lets you switch between a hard jet and a gentle rinse. Comes with 3/4" and 1/2" quick connectors so it fits your hose.

Features

  • Powerful high-pressure jet from an ordinary garden hose
  • Adjustable spray – from hard jet to gentle rinse
  • 3/4" and 1/2" quick connectors included
  • Ergonomic handle with a comfortable grip
  • Perfect for car, pets, patio and garden

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
